subject: Data residency control worksheet and on-prem VPC runbook request
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <security@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: control worksheet + on-prem VPC runbook for EU residency review

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. As part of our procurement/security review at ClearPath Health we need a short packet describing how Redwood would host customer workloads for an EU-only deployment and the controls that prevent cross-region egress. Specifically we are hoping to receive by June 10: 

- A filled copy of your data residency control worksheet (CAIQ/SIG mapping) so our audit team can verify control coverage.
- A concise on-prem/VPC runbook (or diagram + step checklist) that explains: private peering options, egress controls, KMS/HSM key residency and rotation, tenant isolation, and failover behavior.
- Any supplemental evidence you can share (network diagrams, sample peering configs, and a short note on HSM key custody options).

A few clarifying points that matter to us:
1) We require cryptographic keys for customer data to be exclusively provisioned and stored in EU-based HSM or KMS under customer-managed keys. If you have hybrid approaches (local HSM + cloud KMS), please describe how you prevent key escrow outside the region.
2) We need confirmation that telemetry/logs containing request metadata are retained in-region and that audit logs are available for export within 30 days.
3) Please outline fallback routing if the primary EU pool is unavailable—do you have regional fallbacks or automated model-swaps?

If you can send the worksheet and runbook as attachments (PDF/XLSX) and include any diagrams as PDFs, that will help speed review. I can share these with our security operations and procurement.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Security Analyst
ClearPath Health
security@clearpathhealth.com

Attachment: ClearPath_Security_Request_20270530.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <security@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: control worksheet + on-prem VPC runbook for EU residency review

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear ask and deadline. We'll assemble a concise packet and aim to get the initial materials to you by June 8 to leave time for your review. Plan below: 

- I will send the filled CAIQ/controls mapping (XLSX) and a short narrative explaining differences between our hosted, dedicated, and private deployment modes.
- Karthik will produce the VPC runbook + diagram showing peering, NAT/egress controls, and sample firewall rules.
- Marissa will include a short appendix on options/pricing implications if you require Dedicated or an on-prem packaged deployment.

Quick questions to make sure we tailor the runbook: 
1) For the HSM requirement, do you need a vendor-specific FIPS/HSM (e.g., Thales/CloudHSM) recommendation, or is a KMS with imported customer keys acceptable if keys never leave an EU KMS?
2) Do you require per-tenant physical isolation, or is logical isolation (VPC + tenant routing + cryptographic separation) acceptable?

I'll follow up internally and upload a draft to a shared Drive folder. If you have a preferred template for the CAIQ mapping, send it over and we'll map fields directly.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

--
Priya Natarajan
Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: Request: control worksheet + on-prem VPC runbook for EU residency review

Team — forwarding ClearPath's ask (below). They want an EU-only residency packet: CAIQ mapping + VPC/on-prem runbook + HSM keyflow description. Due target: June 8 (we said June 8 to leave time for their review).

Karthik: can you take the runbook + network diagram + one-page HSM/keyflow note? Focus items: private peering (Direct Connect/ExpressRoute equivalents), egress blocking (deny by default), customer-managed keys stored in EU HSM (describe import/export constraints), and a short DR/fallback paragraph that explains fallback behavior in case primary pool is down (model variant fallback vs cross-region failover). Keep it short — 1–2 pages plus diagram.

Marissa: please prepare a 1-paragraph pricing appendix describing how Dedicated capacity or an on-prem packaged option would be provisioned and contracted. Include lead time and whether Dedicated can be locked to EU-only hosts.

I'll coordinate the CAIQ mapping and assemble final packet for delivery to Lena. Please mark high priority — procurement is on a hard timeline.

Thanks,
Priya

Subject: Deliverable: CAIQ mapping + VPC runbook (initial draft)

Hi Lena — please find the initial packet attached. This is a concise draft so you can triage quickly; happy to expand any section you need more detail on.

Summary of attachments:
- control-worksheet-filled.xlsx (CAIQ to Redwood control mapping, sheet 1 lists relevant SOC2/ISO controls we map to CAIQ questions)
- vpc-runbook.pdf (2-page runbook + network diagram: peering options, IP allowlist examples, egress deny-by-default recipe, and DR fallback behavior)
- caiq-mapping.csv (flat export of CAIQ question IDs mapped to our control evidence and doc locations)

Key notes:
- KMS/HSM: Redwood supports customer-managed keys provisioned in EU KMS (CloudKMS/KeyVault/CloudHSM) and can integrate with customer HSM appliances using a bring-your-own-key import flow. We do not escrow keys: import-only flows or HSM-backed keys remain resident in the customer's chosen EU tenant. See vpc-runbook.pdf section 2.2 for the key custody diagram.
- Logs & telemetry: request logs and audit trails for EU deployments are retained in-region by default and available via the audit export endpoint for 30 days; long-term storage options are configurable in the Dedicated/Private packages.
- Fallback behavior: default behavior is automated model-variant fallback within the EU pool; cross-region failover requires explicit customer opt-in and contractual clauses.

If this looks good, let me know and we'll produce a redlined final pack and supply any additional attestations (e.g., SOC 2 scope statements) you need.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

Attachments: control-worksheet-filled.xlsx (XLSX, 185KB); vpc-runbook.pdf (PDF, 420KB); caiq-mapping.csv (CSV, 45KB)
